body.summary: 301 the nested full-size-track-loaders category URL to the live category page
body.reasoning: Live at HTTP 200 with 145 words and no H1, a thin duplicate of the Full Size Track Loaders category. Its canonical points at /product-category/full-size-track-loaders/, which itself 301s, so the canonical currently targets a redirect instead of a live page. Pointing straight at /full-size-track-loaders/ (verified 200) removes the thin duplicate and the canonical-to-redirect hop in one step. Found in the Search Console crawled-not-indexed report; it is the only genuine page fault among the 71 URLs listed.
